description: Every field a call to web may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

depth.description: 1 also reads up to three pages on the same site that the linked pages link to, nearest the request first; 0 or left out reads only the pages themselves

pages.description: how many pages to read, 1 to 12; 6 when left out

query.description: what to search for, phrased for a search engine: the subject, names, versions, dates; left out, the person's own words are searched

search.description: false reads the links alone and searches nothing; left out, the engines are searched too

urls.description: pages to read directly, when the person named or linked them; the links in the person's message are read without being listed here

title: What web takes (craft-agent/1)
